verdict.rationale: HeyGen is a SaaS video platform, so AI insights from user data (for example, video performance suggestions) is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack, however, covers only video generation, revision and storyboard iteration, plus a docs assistant that maps described work to API endpoints. None of this is AI analysis of the user's own data producing insights or suggestions inside the product, so these adjacent features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
